heading: Event-trace errors (-720..-730)
text:
## Event-trace errors (-720..-730) [NERR.13]

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `DS_ERR_FS_VERSION`           | an event-trace session header reports a `ds_version` outside the reader's `<major>.<minor>.` series ([LDET.1.10]) |
| `DS_ERR_FS_UNKNOWN_INJECT`    | an `Atom` carries an unknown field number in the inject band (`1-127`) — an input the writer recorded and this reader cannot deliver, reached whatever version either side is ([RFCS.18.8]) |
| `DS_ERR_FS_DIVERGENCE`           | replay: a re-derived compare atom (`RuleFireAnnotation`/`CallIssued`) differs byte-for-byte from the recorded atom at that `seq`, or is missing/extra/reordered — a determinism failure ([LFST.9.3.7]). Distinct from the `EngineDivergence` stream event. |
| `DS_ERR_FS_RECORDING_INCOMPLETE` (-729) | replay: the recording's first event has a `seq` other than `0` — its stream callback was attached after the engine's first input or sample, so the inputs before it are missing ([LTIM.2.8.5]) |
| `DS_ERR_FS_UNKNOWN_FACT_ID` (-730) | replay: a `FactRetract` names a `fact_id` that no earlier `FactAssert`, `FactEmit` or `ExternalAssert` left in working memory, or that an earlier `FactRetract` already named ([RFCS.7.3]) |

A replayed fact atom naming a schema the stream never announced, or one the
engine does not hold, is `DS_ERR_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` ([RFCS.5.4], [NERR.5]).

`-721` to `-724` are reserved and never reused ([STYL.2.8.7]). A recording's
header is refused as [RFCS.4.7] states.

See the determinism / event-trace doc (NDET) for the session header
(`ds_engine_get_session_header`).
